translations.web: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.
translations.bsb: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.
translations.kjv: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
translations.asv: Watch therefore, for ye know not the day nor the hour.
